descriptionText:
Lot of 7 Todd Zeile baseball cards, 1991-1997:
- 1991 Topps #616 (Cardinals, catcher)
- 1991 Upper Deck #164 (Cardinals, catcher)
- 1992 Topps Stadium Club #544 (Cardinals)
- 1993 Fleer #136 (Cardinals)
- 1997 Topps #473 (Orioles)
- 1997 Score #257 (Orioles)
- 1997 Upper Deck Collector's Choice #364 (Dodgers)

All ungraded, Excellent with light handling wear. Photos show the lot, then the front and back of each card.

Ships in an eBay Standard Envelope.
